# America’s retro pastime: Election betting

Election night in America used to be a party.

Before the advent of radio, election-enthusiasts gathered outside their local newspaper offices, where early returns that arrived by telegraph were immediately shared with the crowd.

On election night in 1892, for example, an estimated 250,000 people packed the streets outside The Pittsburg Dispatch, which used a limelight lantern to project the latest news onto a white curtain hung from the second story of a department store across the street. The Dispatch [reported](https://panewsarchive.psu.edu/lccn/sn84024546/1892-11-09/ed-1/seq-7.pdf) that at least half the crowd was armed with noisemakers:

“The deafening din of tin horns gathered volume every minute, until before 8 o’clock the streets downtown were hidden by dense masses of eager, howling participants, from whose lungs and mechanical organs rose a grand chorus of cheers and blasts of unearthly music.“ — 

In Duluth, MN, crowds waiting for results of the 1920 election were entertained by brass bands, movies, and professional singers. The News Tribune projected updates onto a bulletin board “every minute.” Thousands of Duluthians packed the sidewalks from 7 pm until early the next morning, the paper [reported](https://www.duluthnewstribune.com/community/in-1920-election-night-in-duluth-was-a-party).

“Police squads were kept busy clearing pathways on the sidewalk as the crowd excitedly discussed contents of the bulletins. Cold weather went unnoticed…Pictures of Republican candidates were greeted with cheering and yelling. Women vied with men in eagerness displayed as each bulletin was flashed to the public.“ — 

Nothing, however, could beat the spectacle of election night in New York City.

81844.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* [**Binance**](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/binance-begins-reopening-withdrawals-with-bitcoin-after-6-3-billion-hack)[ reopened withdrawals after its hack](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/binance-begins-reopening-withdrawals-with-bitcoin-after-6-3-billion-hack)

* [**Binance's attackers**](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/chainalysis-flags-defi-receipt-token-route-in-binance-hack)[ routed USDT claims past freezes](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/chainalysis-flags-defi-receipt-token-route-in-binance-hack)

* [**A Linux bug**](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/anza-urges-solana-validators-to-act-on-critical-linux-flaw)[ sent validators and tBTC offline](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/anza-urges-solana-validators-to-act-on-critical-linux-flaw)

* [**BTCPay Server**](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/btcpay-server-urges-shutdown-after-reports-of-hot-wallet-sweeps)[ told operators to shut down](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/btcpay-server-urges-shutdown-after-reports-of-hot-wallet-sweeps)

* [**Morpho**](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/morpho-borrow-rates-hit-roughly-40-as-pt-market-liquidity-dries-up)[ borrow rates hit about 40% after the hack](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/morpho-borrow-rates-hit-roughly-40-as-pt-market-liquidity-dries-up)

Binance reopened withdrawals over the weekend, starting with bitcoin on Sunday. By 7:36 a.m. ET that day, all 15 network groups in its first phase were open, and [U.S. dollar withdrawals came back today](https://thedefiant.io/news/cefi/binance-restores-usd-withdrawals-as-post-hack-reopening-expands). In the first nine and a half hours, customers withdrew $4.649 billion and deposited $1.01 billion, [Binance said](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/binance-posts-4-54-billion-net-outflow-as-tracked-rivals-gain-564-million). It now says it has replaced about 95% of the stolen assets with its own funds. The rest are less-liquid tokens it is still buying. 

So far, Binance has covered the loss with its own money, without counting the frozen funds. On Friday, we wrote that Binance's [$6.34 billion reserve](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/binance-says-it-has-reserved-over-6-34-billion-to-cover-hack-losses) covered the estimated $6.3 billion loss before any frozen funds came back. Only $5 billion of it was held in the stolen tokens, about 80% of the loss. Binance closed most of that gap in three days. It reported [90% replaced on Saturday](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/binance-says-90-of-stolen-assets-replenished-targets-nov-1-restart) and 95% on Sunday. To get there, it drew on its corporate treasury and part of its futures insurance fund. Binance says what remains in that fund still exceeds the coverage its risk framework requires. It also [moved 7,499 BTC](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/binance-confirms-7-499-btc-safu-transfer-after-hack), worth about $581 million, out of its SAFU emergency fund.
